summary: Top Wealth Group Holding Ltd filed a 6-K on October 6, 2026 disclosing a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice dated October 2, 2026. The company's closing bid traded below US$1.00 for 30 consecutive business days from August 20 to October 1, 2026, triggering Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). Nasdaq granted a 180-calendar-day compliance period ending March 31, 2027; a 10-consecutive-day close at or above US$1.00 restores compliance. A second 180-day extension is possible if market value and other initial listing standards are met, with written intent to cure, potentially via reverse stock split. Watch for a reverse split filing and bid-price recovery.
